Mechanically right for Chittering swarm, but the claim “only Fellhammer’s next rebuild would change” is wrong. --compare of all 24 exports at ffb0449 vs 8529288 shows the rule renaming signed-off abilities in 7 lists: big-demons-baby (Forwards, For Blood! → Forwards, for Blood!), melee and ooga-booga (Prophet of Da Great Waaagh! → Prophet of da Great Waaagh!), pubstomper (Herd banner → Herd Banner), purge-goes-the-foe (Broad spectrum data-tether → Broad Spectrum Data-tether), shooty (Might is Right → Might Is Right), fellhammer (Voice eater → Voice Eater). Wahapedia’s casing goes both ways, so the rule is no consistency rule; and a rename on a rebuild also renames the shared DATASHEETS row (the reuse step writes GW’s name, gwName), moves CHECKLIST keys and makes approvals and hand-file entries keyed by the old name stale. data.js is unchanged now, so nothing is wrong yet. Recommendation: do not rebuild Fellhammer alone. Either make the case-only rename explicit per list (fix below: only names a hand file lists), which keeps every other list’s rebuild stable; or, if the owner wants Wahapedia’s casing everywhere, sweep all 7 lists (+ their shared rows) in one change with declarations, not one at a time.

why: Order is right, but the order does not limit anything: every page of a wanted name, of any faction, is passed to locate(), so a note on a list’s unit can be “found” on a same-named datasheet of another faction (Chaos Spawn exists for several Chaos factions, Daemon Princes, Lords of Change). Pages are only of the unit’s own names (unit, leader, also, ref.of, the adding unit), so it cannot match another unit of the same faction; the risk is the same name in another faction. Use another faction’s page only when the list’s faction (or its Wahapedia id) has none of that name (the ally case the comment means).
